title: RIFT Scene Manifest v1
description: Locked consumer-facing scene manifest contract. V4P12 decisions: mesh-parent-chain transform, right-handed/Y-up/-Z-forward, textures.source discriminant, obj_sha1 + scanned_at parity fields. Migrated to tracked docs/schemas/ on 2026-06-21 (was gitignored under Assets/Exports/discovery-plan/cycle-2/stage2/). Cycle 5 (2026-06-21) added optional `semantic` sub-record surfacing hint:map-zone / hint:actor-object / hint:waypoint-poi categories from asset-semantic-index/v1 matrix reports. Cycle 5.1 (2026-06-28) added optional `zone` sub-record surfacing the per-asset zone tuple (expansion/category/zone) resolved from the hint:map-zone scan via direct match or archive-neighbor fallback.

cycle4_producers.description: Producers that have written cycle4 LOD-aware metadata onto this manifest.

cycle4_version.description: Schema version of the cycle4 LOD metadata stamped onto this manifest.

cycle4_last_applied.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent cycle4 LOD patch applied to this manifest.

semantic.description: Cycle 5 surface: typed semantic hint categories extracted from asset-semantic-index/v1 matrix reports. Optional; older manifests pre-dating Cycle 5 omit this field.

zone.description: Cycle 5.1 surface: per-asset zone tuple (expansion/category/zone) resolved from the hint:map-zone scan. method=direct means the asset's own NIF entry in zone-full.json carries the path; method=neighbor means the closest path-bearing NIF in the same archive within +/-150 entry indices was used; method=unmatched means no path-bearing NIF was found in window. Optional; older manifests pre-dating Cycle 5.1 omit this field.

lod_index.description: Asset's rank within its MeshSize or vertex-count family (Cycle 4.1 LOD-aware).

lod_tier_count_in_family.description: Number of assets in the same family as this asset (Cycle 4.1).

categories.description: Ordered hint categories this asset appears under (subset of hint:map-zone / hint:actor-object / hint:waypoint-poi). Empty when the asset appears in no matrix report.

sources.description: Mapping from each known hint category to its matrix-report path (matrix-relative) when the report exists, or to the literal string '<absent>' when the report is missing on disk.

Zone.description: Per-asset zone attribution resolved from the hint:map-zone scan (zone-full.json). The tuple is the canonical identifier (expansion.category.zone); the constituent fields are surfaced for consumers that prefer structured access. method discriminates how the attribution was derived.

tuple.description: Canonical zone identifier of the form 'expansion.category.zone' (e.g. 'vanilla.world_objects.props'). Null when method='unmatched'.

expansion.description: Game expansion the zone belongs to. Defaults to 'vanilla' when the path omits the expansion segment.

category.description: Top-level content category (e.g. world_objects, vfx, creatures). Null when method='unmatched'.

name.description: Zone name within the category (e.g. props, architecture, nature). Null when method='unmatched'.

method.description: How the zone attribution was derived: direct (asset's own NIF entry in zone-full.json carries the path), neighbor (closest path-bearing NIF in same archive within +/-150 entry indices), unmatched (no path-bearing NIF in window — fields are null).

delta.description: Entry-index distance to the path-bearing NIF that provided the attribution. 0 when method='direct'; 0-150 when method='neighbor'; null when method='unmatched'.

first4.description: First4 magic of the zone-full entry that provided the attribution (4-byte hex, lowercased). Standard Gamebryo NIF magic is 47616d65 ('Game'). Recorded for transparency only -- First4 alone does NOT discriminate siblings from coincidental neighbors; the archive-neighbor verification handoff found all 5 closest and all 3 farthest neighbors share the same First4. Entry-Index Delta is the discriminating signal. Empty string when method='unmatched'. IN DELIVERY JSON (riftflythrough-delivery.json) this field is emitted as the top-level key zone_first4 (prefix-flat API surface); the schema-side nested form zone.first4 is the durable manifest form.

confidence.description: Zone attribution confidence derived from (method, |delta|). high = direct match (delta=0) or tight co-bundled sibling (|delta|<=5); medium = plausible sibling (6<=|delta|<=30); low = coincidental adjacency (|delta|>30); null = unmatched (no attribution). Consumers can opt out of low-confidence attributions by filtering on this field. See docs/handoffs/2026-06-28-archive-neighbor-verification.md for the threshold calibration.
